what_this_is: The founder's rulings over PTF-TOLEDO-OH-NEW-MARKET-001's grouped packet, transcribed verbatim. It is kept apart from the packet because the packet is regenerated by an idempotent builder and a ruling must not live where a rebuild can erase it.
who_decided_and_who_typed: decided_by is the founder, who ruled in session. recorded_by is the agent that transcribed the ruling. Nothing here was inferred, defaulted or completed by the agent, and no approval field carries a human name the human did not put there.

rulings.founder_words: Keep Bowling Green OUT of the Toledo market for this promotion. Do not create or widen a Toledo fringe corridor to include Bowling Green. Preserve the evidence and candidates for a future Bowling Green / northwest Ohio market decision.

what_it_changes.corridor: toledo-oh__bowling-green is REMOVED from the contract that gets registered. It is not narrowed, not suppressed below a minimum, and not left in place with zero rows: the founder ruled that no Toledo fringe corridor may reach Bowling Green.

Do not invent a rebrand, merge, duplicate retirement, or same-campus ruling merely to increase coverage. These items are non-blocking and are not part of the clean promotion inventory.

what_it_changes.the_precedent_test: An existing signed precedent is 'fully deterministic' only when a prior order's SIGNED ruling settles this exact disposition on facts this market already holds. A precedent that merely resembles the case does not qualify, and the promotion order may not stretch one to admit a row.

a_conflict_the_agent_must_not_resolve_si.what: The ruling directs that Bowling Green stay OUT, and then restates the clean promotion set as 17 CLEAN_PET_FRIENDLY and 10 CLEAN_VERIFIED_NO_PETS. Those two statements disagree: 17/10 are the counts WITH Bowling Green in, because two of the seventeen and one of the ten are Bowling Green properties.
a_conflict_the_agent_must_not_resolve_si.how_it_is_carried_forward: The EXPLICIT RULING governs and the restated counts are read as a quotation of the prior report, not as a second decision. Bowling Green is out and the promotion set is 15/9. This is recorded rather than quietly reconciled because a promotion order that silently published three Bowling Green pages under a ruling that excluded them would be exactly the class of defect no technical gate catches.
a_conflict_the_agent_must_not_resolve_si.if_the_founder_meant_17_and_10: then ruling R1 is withdrawn or narrowed, and the founder must say so; the promotion order fails closed on the count gate in its Phase 2 rather than choosing.
